content: Apply local code changes to the running setup: (1) cargo build --release -p fabro-cli (2) install -m 755 target/release/fabro ~/.fabro/bin/fabro — CLI in ~/.fabro/bin is never auto-refreshed (3) cargo dev docker-build --arch amd64 --tag ghcr.io/fabro-sh/fabro:local (4) docker compose up -d. Compose (repo docker-compose.yaml) references ghcr.io/fabro-sh/fabro:${FABRO_VERSION:-nightly}; repo .env pins FABRO_VERSION=local so compose uses the locally built image instead of the pulled nightly. A plain restart does NOT apply code changes — the image rebuild is required. /storage volume persists server data and dev-token across restarts. Verified 2026-08-21 with ba07e47.

Update loop for feature work: feature branch (feat/...) carries code, lab branch (denkhaus-lab) carries the config under test (.fabro/Dockerfile.mise + project.toml image.dockerfile); watch branch state before fabro run — the run clones the CHECKED-OUT branch, not the pushed one. Cold build surfaces as 'building fabro-runner-<sha12>...' in CLI output; verify reuse via absence of snapshot.creating in run events.

name: just-up-pipeline-facts
description: build-image produces ghcr.io/fabro-sh/fabro:local via cargo dev docker-build (musl, cargo-zigbuild, docker-volume caches survive runs); compose-up honors FABRO_VERSION override, defaults to local since 34faf268a. clean recipe = stale mode before/after (>=6h incremental dirs only); deps/ rlib variants keep growing — 'just clean sweep' (cargo-sweep in ~/.cargo/bin) or 'all' under disk pressure. target/ grew 52GB in one day (937 incremental dirs / 150 crates). Runner images: fabro auto-builds from image.dockerfile, content-hash tag fabro-runner-<sha12>, rg/nu/go/just baked via mise use -g (aqua:BurntSushi/ripgrep@15.2.0).

name: vault-token-debugging
description: Server vault secrets live in the SQLite store: /storage/db/fabro.sqlite3, table 'secrets', columns (name, value, ...) — PLAINTEXT values (GITHUB_TOKEN prefix github_pat_ for fine-grained PATs, ghs_ for installation tokens which are rejected as static). Debug flow for token suspicions: docker cp the sqlite out, read via python sqlite3, direct curl with the token against api.github.com (with User-Agent!), compare with the failing call's headers before blaming scopes. fabro secret CLI only has list/rm/set — no show by design.
